items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You, him, Richie Kamuca, and Holman was the fourth tenor player.

ctx.x: Yes. I was very pleased and surprised. Apparently, Richie Kamuca was joining the band the same day. He said: “I’m trying for more of a jazz band now.”
He’d lost his shirt on the Innovation band. He lost one hundred and twenty five thousand dollars in four months with that forty-piece band with strings and French horns.
